CustomField.description: Checks the total revenue over the last 365 days to determine the beacon account type. >100000 = Large Account, > 40000 = Mid - Tier Account, < 40000 = SME Account.
CustomField.formula: IF( Total_Revenue_Last_365_Days__c >= 100000, "Large Account", IF( Total_Revenue_Last_365_Days__c >= 40000, "Mid-Tier Account", IF( Total_Revenue_Last_365_Days__c = 0, "No Revenue", "SME Account" ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checks the total revenue over the last 365 days to determine the beacon account type. >100000 = Large Account, > 40000 = Mid - Tier Account, < 40000 = SME Account.
CustomField.label: Size
